name: Post for Me
headline: Post for Me - Automate Social Media Posts
short_description: Post for Me automates and schedules social media posts across platforms like Twitter/X, Bluesky, and others. Marketing teams benefit from streamlined content distribution, saving time and ensuring consistent posting. It integrates with apps using NestJS, React Router, and Supabase, connecting to major social media APIs for post management.
author: DayMoonDevelopment

sections.overview:
Post for Me is a social media automation platform that lets users schedule and distribute posts across multiple platforms including Twitter/X and Bluesky from a single dashboard. The platform is built on NestJS backend infrastructure with a React Router frontend, using Supabase for data management and Trigger.dev for background job processing. It solves the workflow problem of manually posting to multiple social networks by centralizing scheduling and automation. Marketing teams and content creators benefit from streamlined content distribution, consistent posting schedules, and reduced manual effort across social channels.
Schedule multi-platform posts in advance across Twitter/X and Bluesky
Automate recurring social media content distribution
Centralize social media management from a single dashboard
Maintain consistent posting schedules across multiple platforms
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/DayMoonDevelopment/post-for-me`
sections.usage:
```
Create a social media post for [PLATFORM] about [TOPIC]. The tone should be [TONE: professional, casual, humorous, etc.], and the post should be [LENGTH: short, medium, long]. Include relevant hashtags and a call-to-action. Format the post for [PLATFORM: Twitter/X, Bluesky, etc.] and ensure it aligns with our brand voice: [BRAND VOICE DESCRIPTION].
```
Copy

```
Here’s a social media post for Twitter/X about the launch of our new AI-powered scheduling tool, 'Post for Me' (fictional product). Tone: professional yet engaging. Length: medium.

🚀 Exciting news! We’re thrilled to announce the launch of **Post for Me**—your ultimate AI-powered social media scheduling assistant! 📅✨

Say goodbye to manual posting and hello to seamless content distribution across Twitter/X, Bluesky, and more. With Post for Me, you can:
✅ Schedule posts in advance
✅ Auto-generate captions with AI
✅ Track engagement in real-time

Ready to save time and boost your social media presence? Try it today! 👉 [Link to product page]

#SocialMedia #AI #MarketingTools #PostForMe #Automation

Let us know in the replies what features you’d love to see next! 👇
```
